title: ADR-008 Core-to-Core Dependency Exception Register
description: Machine-readable serialization of the ADR-008 closed register of Core-to-Core dependency exceptions. ADR-008 (Markdown) remains the architectural authority; this register is a derived representation and MUST NOT redefine architecture.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the register schema. Incremented when the data contract changes in a breaking way.

authority.description: The architectural authority this register serializes.

source.description: Path to the authoritative ADR document.

edges.description: Closed list of approved Core-to-Core dependency exceptions.

layer.description: Layer relationship. This register covers only Core-to-Core edges.

categories.description: All classifications that apply to this edge. A single edge may belong to multiple classifications (e.g., storefront -> catalog is both a capability exception and a value-import exception). This is the sole classification field.

importKind.description: Whether the dependency is type-only, value, or a mix of both.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle status: approved exception, deprecated pattern tracked for removal, or scheduled migration candidate.

adrReference.description: Reference back to ADR-008, including the specific register section/table where practical.

removalCandidate.description: Removal candidate tracking, mirroring ADR-008 'Candidates for Removal'. Required when lifecycle is 'migration-candidate'.

criteria.description: The ADR-008 acceptance criteria this dependency fails.

action.description: The migration action required to remove or refactor the dependency.
